description: 固定上游安装脚本的显示文本适配；除代码页与 pause 显示支持外，不更改命令、控制流或协议同意要求。

scripts.preserved_english_reason: 保留文件名、品牌、GPU 型号、哈希、Discord 频道/帖子原名及 INI 键；它们用于准确定位或输入。ASCII 图案、纯版本号和开发注释不翻译。生成卸载脚本的命令保持原样，其显示提示另行翻译。

entries.source: echo Coping is strong with this one...
entries.translation: echo 这次也要稳住...

entries.source: echo Detected OptiScaler.sln or .git files^^!
entries.translation: echo 检测到 OptiScaler.sln 或 .git 文件^^!

entries.source: echo If .sln or .git files are in the folder, congratz, you have the source code.
entries.translation: echo 如果文件夹中有 .sln 或 .git 文件，说明你下载的是源代码。

entries.source: echo Now please try properly downloading OptiScaler.
entries.translation: echo 请重新下载正确的 OptiScaler 发行包。

entries.source: echo Hint - use the Releases page on GitHub, or RTFM :^)
entries.translation: echo 提示 - 请使用 GitHub 的 Releases 页面，或阅读使用说明 :^)

entries.source: echo P.S. If you somehow have both the OptiScaler.dll and .sln file, then be nice, just delete the .sln file, re-run the BAT setup and hope for the best.
entries.translation: echo 补充：如果同时存在 OptiScaler.dll 和 .sln 文件，请删除 .sln 文件后重新运行 BAT 安装脚本。

entries.source: echo OptiScaler "OptiScaler.dll" file is not found^^!
entries.translation: echo 未找到 OptiScaler 文件 "OptiScaler.dll"^^!

entries.source: echo Detected a folder permissions issue most likely. Might have more luck running the BAT as admin.
entries.translation: echo 可能存在文件夹权限问题，可以尝试以管理员身份运行 BAT 脚本。

entries.source: echo OR
entries.translation: echo 或者

entries.source: echo If "OptiScaler.dll" exists, please manually rename to a supported filename ^(e.g. dxgi/winmm.dll^) and you are done^^!
entries.translation: echo 如果 "OptiScaler.dll" 确实存在，请手动改为支持的文件名 ^(例如 dxgi/winmm.dll^) 即可^^!

entries.source: echo No need to run the setup BAT again after renaming.
entries.translation: echo 重命名后无需再次运行 BAT 安装脚本。

entries.source: echo WARNING: Possible old OptiScaler file^(s^) detected^^!
entries.translation: echo 警告：可能检测到了旧版 OptiScaler 文件^(一个或多个^)^^!

entries.source: for %%F in (!OPTI_DLL_LIST!) do echo   - %%F ^(original filename: OptiScaler.dll^)
entries.translation: for %%F in (!OPTI_DLL_LIST!) do echo   - %%F ^(原始文件名：OptiScaler.dll^)

entries.source: echo These files may conflict with the current version of OptiScaler.
entries.translation: echo 这些文件可能与当前版本的 OptiScaler 冲突。

entries.source: echo It is recommended to delete them.
entries.translation: echo 建议删除这些文件。

entries.source: echo Do you want to delete these files?
entries.translation: echo 要删除这些文件吗？

entries.source: echo [1] Yes
entries.translation: echo [1] 是

entries.source: echo [2] No
entries.translation: echo [2] 否

entries.source: set /p "USER_CHOICE=Waiting - "
entries.translation: set /p "USER_CHOICE=等待输入 - "

entries.source: echo Deleted nvapi64.dll
entries.translation: echo 已删除 nvapi64.dll

entries.source: echo Deleted nvngx.dll
entries.translation: echo 已删除 nvngx.dll

entries.source: echo Deleted OptiScaler.asi
entries.translation: echo 已删除 OptiScaler.asi

entries.source: echo Deleted Remove OptiScaler.bat
entries.translation: echo 已删除 Remove OptiScaler.bat

entries.source: echo Deleted Remove_OptiScaler.bat
entries.translation: echo 已删除 Remove_OptiScaler.bat

entries.source: echo Deleted %%F
entries.translation: echo 已删除 %%F

entries.source: echo Done^^!
entries.translation: echo 完成^^!

entries.source: echo Skipping deletion. Note that these files may cause issues.
entries.translation: echo 跳过删除。请注意，这些文件可能导致问题。

entries.source: echo Found Engine folder. If this is an Unreal Engine game, then please extract Optiscaler to #CODENAME#\Binaries\Win64
entries.translation: echo 发现 Engine 文件夹。如果这是 Unreal Engine 游戏，请将 Optiscaler 解压到 #CODENAME#\Binaries\Win64

entries.source: echo Do not extract to the Engine folder^^!
entries.translation: echo 不要解压到 Engine 文件夹^^!

entries.source: echo Example - \Jedi Survivor\SwGame\Binaries\Win64, \Witchfire\Witchfire\Binaries\Win64
entries.translation: echo 示例 - \Jedi Survivor\SwGame\Binaries\Win64, \Witchfire\Witchfire\Binaries\Win64

entries.source: echo Continue installation to current folder?
entries.translation: echo 继续安装到当前文件夹吗？

entries.source: echo [1] Yes
entries.translation: echo [1] 是

entries.source: echo [2] No
entries.translation: echo [2] 否

entries.source: set /p continueChoice="Waiting - "
entries.translation: set /p continueChoice="等待输入 - "

entries.source: echo Choose a filename for OptiScaler (default is dxgi.dll, most compatible):
entries.translation: echo 请选择 OptiScaler 的文件名 (默认 dxgi.dll，兼容性最好)：

entries.source: echo (For Vulkan, use winmm.dll. For XGP/MS Store, winmm/version.dll may be better)
entries.translation: echo (Vulkan 请使用 winmm.dll；XGP/MS Store 使用 winmm/version.dll 可能更合适)

entries.source: set /p filenameChoice="Enter 1-8 (or press Enter for default): "
entries.translation: set /p filenameChoice="输入 1-8 (或按 Enter 使用默认值)： "

entries.source: echo Invalid choice. Please select a valid option.
entries.translation: echo 选择无效，请选择有效选项。

entries.source: echo WARNING: %selectedFilename% already exists in the current folder.
entries.translation: echo 警告：当前文件夹中已存在 %selectedFilename%。

entries.source: echo Do you want to overwrite %selectedFilename%?
entries.translation: echo 要覆盖 %selectedFilename% 吗？

entries.source: echo [1] Yes
entries.translation: echo [1] 是

entries.source: echo [2] No
entries.translation: echo [2] 否

entries.source: set /p overwriteChoice="Waiting - "
entries.translation: set /p overwriteChoice="等待输入 - "

entries.source: echo WARNING: This proxy has a reported Streamline conflict that can grey out
entries.translation: echo 警告：已有报告指出，此代理与 Streamline 冲突时，可能导致

entries.source: echo Cyberpunk's Ray Reconstruction option. Try dxgi.dll or another compatible
entries.translation: echo Cyberpunk 的光线重建选项变灰。遇到此问题请尝试 dxgi.dll 或其他兼容

entries.source: echo proxy if that happens. Back up existing ReShade or other loaders first.
entries.translation: echo 代理。请先备份现有的 ReShade 或其他加载器。

entries.source: echo See INSTALL-DLSSNR.md for the confirmed upstream report.
entries.translation: echo 已确认的上游问题报告请参阅 INSTALL-DLSSNR.md。

entries.source: echo Using wine, skipping over spoofing checks.
entries.translation: echo 检测到 Wine，跳过显卡身份伪装检查。

entries.source: echo If you need, you can disable spoofing by setting Dxgi=false in the config
entries.translation: echo 如有需要，可在配置中设置 Dxgi=false 来禁用显卡身份伪装

entries.source: echo Nvidia driver files detected.
entries.translation: echo 检测到 Nvidia 驱动文件。

entries.source: echo Are you using an Nvidia GPU or AMD/Intel GPU?
entries.translation: echo 你使用的是 Nvidia 显卡，还是 AMD/Intel 显卡？

entries.source: set /p gpuChoice="Enter 1 or 2 (Detected Nvidia): "
entries.translation: set /p gpuChoice="输入 1 或 2 (检测到 Nvidia)： "

entries.source: set /p gpuChoice="Enter 1 or 2 (Detected AMD/Intel): "
entries.translation: set /p gpuChoice="输入 1 或 2 (检测到 AMD/Intel)： "

entries.source: echo Invalid input. Please enter 1 or 2.
entries.translation: echo 输入无效，请输入 1 或 2。

entries.source: echo Will you try to use DLSS inputs to replace with FSR/XeSS? (enables Nvidia spoofing, required for DLSS-FG, Reflex-^>AL2)
entries.translation: echo 是否通过 DLSS 输入使用 FSR/XeSS？ (这会启用 Nvidia 身份伪装；DLSS-FG、Reflex-^>AL2 需要此功能)

entries.source: echo If you want to change the setting later, edit OptiScaler.ini and set Dxgi=false to disable spoofing and reverse.
entries.translation: echo 以后可编辑 OptiScaler.ini，将 Dxgi=false 设为禁用显卡身份伪装，反之则启用。

entries.source: echo [1] Yes
entries.translation: echo [1] 是

entries.source: echo [2] No
entries.translation: echo [2] 否

entries.source: set /p enablingSpoofing="Enter 1 or 2 (or press Enter for Yes): "
entries.translation: set /p enablingSpoofing="输入 1 或 2 (或按 Enter 选择“是”)： "

entries.source: echo Config file not found: %configFile%
entries.translation: echo 未找到配置文件：%configFile%

entries.source: echo AMD/Intel GPU detected - running OptiPatcher check.
entries.translation: echo 检测到 AMD/Intel 显卡 - 正在检查 OptiPatcher。

entries.source: echo OptiPatcher found: !foundOptiPatcher!
entries.translation: echo 找到 OptiPatcher：!foundOptiPatcher!

entries.source: echo If the existing version works properly, might be best to keep it.
entries.translation: echo 如果现有版本工作正常，建议保留。

entries.source: echo Do you want to re-download a possibly newer version?
entries.translation: echo 是否重新下载可能更新的版本？

entries.source: echo [1] Yes
entries.translation: echo [1] 是

entries.source: echo [2] No
entries.translation: echo [2] 否

entries.source: set /p optiRedownload="Waiting - "
entries.translation: set /p optiRedownload="等待输入 - "

entries.source: echo Deleting !foundOptiPatcher!...
entries.translation: echo 正在删除 !foundOptiPatcher!...

entries.source: echo Keeping existing OptiPatcher - skipping download.
entries.translation: echo 保留现有 OptiPatcher - 跳过下载。

entries.source: echo Checking for OptiPatcher compatibility...
entries.translation: echo 正在检查 OptiPatcher 兼容性...

entries.source: echo Press Ctrl+C if this gets stuck to skip to setup completion.
entries.translation: echo 如果卡住，可按 Ctrl+C 跳过并完成安装。

entries.source: echo Offline or GitHub blocked. Skipping OptiPatcher check.
entries.translation: echo 网络离线或 GitHub 无法访问，跳过 OptiPatcher 检查。

entries.source: echo OptiPatcher support detected^^!
entries.translation: echo 检测到 OptiPatcher 支持^^!

entries.source: echo An Opti plugin used for unlocking DLSS/DLSS-FG inputs, avoiding spoofing and performance overhead in supported games.
entries.translation: echo 该 Opti 插件可在支持的游戏中解锁 DLSS/DLSS-FG 输入，避免显卡身份伪装和性能开销。

entries.source: echo More info available on OptiPatcher Github
entries.translation: echo 更多信息请参阅 OptiPatcher 的 Github 页面

entries.source: echo Download OptiPatcher.asi?
entries.translation: echo 下载 OptiPatcher.asi 吗？

entries.source: echo [1] Yes
entries.translation: echo [1] 是

entries.source: echo [2] No
entries.translation: echo [2] 否

entries.source: set /p downloadOptiPatcher="Waiting - "
entries.translation: set /p downloadOptiPatcher="等待输入 - "

entries.source: echo Preparing plugins folder...
entries.translation: echo 正在准备 plugins 文件夹...

entries.source: echo Downloading OptiPatcher...
entries.translation: echo 正在下载 OptiPatcher...

entries.source: echo Press Ctrl+C if this gets stuck to skip to setup completion.
entries.translation: echo 如果卡住，可按 Ctrl+C 跳过并完成安装。

entries.source: echo OptiPatcher.asi downloaded successfully.
entries.translation: echo OptiPatcher.asi 下载成功。

entries.source: echo Enabling ASI loading in OptiScaler.ini...
entries.translation: echo 正在 OptiScaler.ini 中启用 ASI 加载...

entries.source: echo Successfully enabled ASI loading in OptiScaler.ini^^!
entries.translation: echo 已在 OptiScaler.ini 中成功启用 ASI 加载^^!

entries.source: echo Warning: OptiScaler.ini not found, could not enable LoadAsiPlugins.
entries.translation: echo 警告：未找到 OptiScaler.ini，无法启用 LoadAsiPlugins。

entries.source: echo Failed to download OptiPatcher.asi.
entries.translation: echo OptiPatcher.asi 下载失败。

entries.source: echo Removing previous %selectedFilename%...
entries.translation: echo 正在移除旧的 %selectedFilename%...

entries.source: echo Renaming OptiScaler file to %selectedFilename%...
entries.translation: echo 正在将 OptiScaler 文件重命名为 %selectedFilename%...

entries.source: echo ERROR: Failed to rename OptiScaler file to %selectedFilename%. Most likely due to folder permissions issues.
entries.translation: echo 错误：无法将 OptiScaler 文件重命名为 %selectedFilename%。可能是文件夹权限问题。

entries.source: echo Please rename OptiScaler.dll manually to %selectedFilename%^^! No need to run setup BAT again after that.
entries.translation: echo 请手动将 OptiScaler.dll 重命名为 %selectedFilename%^^! 此后无需再次运行 BAT 安装脚本。

entries.source: echo  OptiScaler setup completed successfully...
entries.translation: echo  OptiScaler 安装成功...

entries.source: echo   DLSS 5 Neural Rendering
entries.translation: echo   DLSS 5 神经渲染

entries.source: echo   nvngx_dlssnr.dll found here.
entries.translation: echo   已在当前文件夹找到 nvngx_dlssnr.dll。

entries.source: echo   ShortFuse cross-generation runtime detected.
entries.translation: echo   检测到 ShortFuse 跨代运行库。

entries.source: echo   This build supports RTX 20, 30, 40, and 50 series GPUs.
entries.translation: echo   此版本支持 RTX 20、30、40 和 50 系列显卡。

entries.source: echo   Original NVIDIA 310.8 runtime detected.
entries.translation: echo   检测到 NVIDIA 原版 310.8 运行库。

entries.source: echo   This file is for RTX 50. RTX 20, 30, and 40 users must replace
entries.translation: echo   此文件适用于 RTX 50。RTX 20、30 和 40 用户必须将其替换为

entries.source: echo   it with ShortFuse's pinned cross-generation compatibility runtime.
entries.translation: echo   ShortFuse 置顶帖子中的跨代兼容运行库。

entries.source: echo   WARNING: This runtime hash is not one documented by this release.
entries.translation: echo   警告：此运行库的哈希不属于本发行版记录的已知哈希。

entries.source: echo   Do not assume that it supports your GPU or came from a trusted source.
entries.translation: echo   不要据此认为它支持你的显卡，或来自可信来源。

entries.source: echo   nvngx_dlssnr.dll was NOT found in this folder.
entries.translation: echo   当前文件夹中未找到 nvngx_dlssnr.dll。

entries.source: echo   Neural Rendering needs it, but it cannot be redistributed here.
entries.translation: echo   神经渲染需要此文件，但本项目无法随包分发它。

entries.source: echo   Copy the GPU-appropriate 310.8 runtime into THIS folder - the
entries.translation: echo   请将适合你显卡的 310.8 运行库复制到当前文件夹，也就是

entries.source: echo   same one holding the game executable and the renamed OptiScaler.
entries.translation: echo   游戏可执行文件与重命名后的 OptiScaler 所在的文件夹。

entries.source: echo   One copy per game. There is no shared or system-wide location.
entries.translation: echo   每个游戏都需要单独放置一份，没有共享或系统级位置。

entries.source: echo   Two similarly named files matter here, one character apart:
entries.translation: echo   请区分以下两个仅相差一个字符的文件名：

entries.source: echo     nvngx.dll_dlssnr.dll   ships in this package  ^(about 13 KB^)
entries.translation: echo     nvngx.dll_dlssnr.dll   本发行包自带          ^(约 13 KB^)

entries.source: echo     nvngx_dlssnr.dll       you supply it          ^(about 165 MB^)
entries.translation: echo     nvngx_dlssnr.dll       需要你自行提供        ^(约 165 MB^)

entries.source: echo   Runtime required by GPU:
entries.translation: echo   各显卡所需的运行库：

entries.source: echo     RTX 50          original NVIDIA 310.8
entries.translation: echo     RTX 50          NVIDIA 原版 310.8

entries.source: echo     RTX 20/30/40    ShortFuse cross-generation 310.8
entries.translation: echo     RTX 20/30/40    ShortFuse 跨代版 310.8

entries.source: echo   Obtain the compatibility runtime only from ShortFuse's pinned thread
entries.translation: echo   兼容运行库请仅从 RenoDX Discord 中 ShortFuse 的置顶帖子获取

entries.source: echo   in the RenoDX Discord: https://discord.com/invite/renodx
entries.translation: echo   RenoDX Discord 地址：https://discord.com/invite/renodx

entries.source: echo   Channel: dlss5-forum ^> Patched DLSS-NR for RTX20, RTX30, and RTX40
entries.translation: echo   频道：dlss5-forum ^> Patched DLSS-NR for RTX20, RTX30, and RTX40

entries.source: echo   The compatibility DLL is modified, so its NVIDIA signature does not
entries.translation: echo   兼容 DLL 经过修改，因此无法通过 NVIDIA 签名验证。

entries.source: echo   validate. Keep security protection on and verify the exact hash above.
entries.translation: echo   请保持安全防护开启，并核对上述完整哈希。

entries.source: echo   Neural Rendering is OFF by default. Turn it on in the OptiScaler
entries.translation: echo   神经渲染默认关闭。可在 OptiScaler 浮层菜单中开启

entries.source: echo   overlay under "DLSS Neural Rendering", or set Enabled=true under
entries.translation: echo   "DLSS Neural Rendering"，或将 Enabled=true 写入

entries.source: echo   the DlssNr section of OptiScaler.ini.
entries.translation: echo   OptiScaler.ini 的 DlssNr 配置节。

entries.source: echo   RTX 20, 30, 40, and 50 are supported with the correct runtime.
entries.translation: echo   使用正确运行库时，支持 RTX 20、30、40 和 50 系列。

entries.source: echo   Driver 616.56 or newer is required. Start with one pass on RTX 20/30.
entries.translation: echo   需要 616.56 或更新的驱动。RTX 20/30 建议先从单遍渲染开始。

entries.source: echo echo Coping is strong with this one...
entries.translation: echo echo 这次也要稳住...

entries.source: echo echo v2.8 - now with OptiPatcher support
entries.translation: echo echo v2.8 - 现已支持 OptiPatcher

entries.source: echo     echo Existing OptiScaler installation detected^^^^!
entries.translation: echo     echo 检测到现有 OptiScaler 安装^^^^!

entries.source: echo     for %%%%F in ^(!OPTI_DLL_LIST!^) do echo   - %%%%F - original filename: OptiScaler.dll
entries.translation: echo     for %%%%F in ^(!OPTI_DLL_LIST!^) do echo   - %%%%F - 原始文件名：OptiScaler.dll

entries.source: echo echo Do you want to remove OptiScaler?
entries.translation: echo echo 要卸载 OptiScaler 吗？

entries.source: echo echo [1] Yes
entries.translation: echo echo [1] 是

entries.source: echo echo [2] No
entries.translation: echo echo [2] 否

entries.source: echo set /p removeChoice="Waiting - "
entries.translation: echo set /p removeChoice="等待输入 - "

entries.source: echo     echo Deleting OptiPatcher if present
entries.translation: echo     echo 如存在 OptiPatcher，则将其删除

entries.source: echo     echo OptiScaler removed^^^^! Ignore the warnings about missing files.
entries.translation: echo     echo OptiScaler 已移除^^^^! 可忽略文件不存在的警告。

entries.source: echo     echo Operation cancelled.
entries.translation: echo     echo 操作已取消。

entries.source: echo Uninstaller created.
entries.translation: echo 已创建卸载脚本。

entries.translation: echo "用法：$0 [选项]"

entries.source: echo  Streamline files fetcher
entries.translation: echo  Streamline 文件获取工具

entries.source: echo [1] Download latest Streamline DLLs
entries.translation: echo [1] 下载最新的 Streamline DLL

entries.source: echo [2] Delete "streamline" folder
entries.translation: echo [2] 删除 "streamline" 文件夹

entries.source: choice /c 12 /n /m "Select an option (1 or 2): "
entries.translation: choice /c 12 /n /m "请选择选项 (1 或 2)： "

entries.source: echo Deleting "streamline" folder and all its contents...
entries.translation: echo 正在删除 "streamline" 文件夹及其所有内容...

entries.source: echo Done.
entries.translation: echo 完成。

entries.source: echo Folder "streamline" does not exist. Nothing to delete.
entries.translation: echo 文件夹 "streamline" 不存在，无需删除。

entries.source: echo --- Looking up latest release info ---
entries.translation: echo --- 正在查询最新发行版信息 ---

entries.source: "if (-not $asset) { Write-Error 'No .zip asset found in latest release.'; exit 1 }" ^
entries.translation: "if (-not $asset) { Write-Error '最新发行版中未找到 .zip 下载文件。'; exit 1 }" ^

entries.source: "Write-Host ('Found asset: ' + $asset.name)"
entries.translation: "Write-Host ('找到下载文件：' + $asset.name)"

entries.source: echo ERROR: Could not determine the latest release asset URL.
entries.translation: echo 错误：无法确定最新发行版下载文件的 URL。

entries.source: echo ERROR: Asset URL was empty.
entries.translation: echo 错误：下载文件的 URL 为空。

entries.source: echo Download URL: %ASSET_URL%
entries.translation: echo 下载 URL：%ASSET_URL%

entries.source: echo --- Downloading %ASSET_NAME% ---
entries.translation: echo --- 正在下载 %ASSET_NAME% ---

entries.source: echo ERROR: Download failed.
entries.translation: echo 错误：下载失败。

entries.source: echo --- Extracting archive ---
entries.translation: echo --- 正在解压归档文件 ---

entries.source: echo ERROR: Extraction failed.
entries.translation: echo 错误：解压失败。

entries.source: echo --- Searching for bin\x64 folders and copying .dll files ---
entries.translation: echo --- 正在查找 bin\x64 文件夹并复制 .dll 文件 ---

entries.translation: echo   找到：%%D

entries.translation: echo 警告：归档文件中未找到 bin\x64 文件夹。

entries.translation: echo 归档文件结构可能已变化，请手动检查 "%EXTRACTDIR%"。

entries.source: echo Done. DLLs copied to: %DEST%
entries.translation: echo 完成。DLL 已复制到：%DEST%

entries.source: echo Script finished with errors. Temp files kept at:
entries.translation: echo 脚本运行出错，临时文件保留在：

entries.translation: echo 临时文件已清理。

scripts.preserved_english_reason: 保留参数名、URL/路径、文件名、哈希、签名字段、许可证文件正文和错误对象属性；所有自有 Write-Host/throw 消息已翻译。不得代替用户传入 -AcceptNvidiaLicenses。

entries.source: throw 'Read docs/DLSS-FRAME-GENERATION.md and the linked NVIDIA licences, then pass -AcceptNvidiaLicenses if you agree. Nothing was installed.'
entries.translation: throw '请阅读 docs/DLSS-FRAME-GENERATION.md 及其中链接的 NVIDIA 许可协议；只有同意后才可传入 -AcceptNvidiaLicenses。未安装任何内容。'

entries.source: throw 'Run this on Windows: NVIDIA Authenticode signatures must be verified.'
entries.translation: throw '请在 Windows 上运行：必须验证 NVIDIA Authenticode 签名。'

entries.source: throw "Hash mismatch: $Path. Not replacing this file; back up and move an old stack aside yourself."
entries.translation: throw "哈希不匹配：$Path。不会替换此文件；请自行备份并移走旧版文件。"

entries.source: throw "NVIDIA signature verification failed: $Path ($($signature.Status)). Do not disable signature checking or antivirus."
entries.translation: throw "NVIDIA 签名验证失败：$Path ($($signature.Status))。不要关闭签名检查或杀毒软件。"

entries.source: throw 'Destination must be the dedicated streamline subfolder, normally GAME\OptiScaler\streamline.'
entries.translation: throw '目标必须是专用的 streamline 子文件夹，通常为 GAME\OptiScaler\streamline。'

entries.source: throw "Unexpected file or directory in destination: $($existing.FullName). Use a clean dedicated folder."
entries.translation: throw "目标位置存在非预期的文件或文件夹：$($existing.FullName)。请使用干净的专用文件夹。"

entries.source: Write-Host "Downloading NVIDIA Streamline $($manifest.version) from $($manifest.archiveUrl)"
entries.translation: Write-Host "正在下载 NVIDIA Streamline $($manifest.version)，来源：$($manifest.archiveUrl)"

entries.source: throw "Official archive checksum mismatch. Untrusted download retained for inspection at $downloadPath; nothing installed."
entries.translation: throw "官方归档文件校验和不匹配。不可信的下载文件保留在 $downloadPath 以供检查；未安装任何内容。"

entries.source: throw "Wrong or damaged Streamline archive: $ArchivePath. Expected SHA-256 $($manifest.archiveSha256)."
entries.translation: throw "Streamline 归档文件不正确或已损坏：$ArchivePath。预期 SHA-256 为 $($manifest.archiveSha256)。"

entries.source: if (-not $entry) { throw "Missing required SDK file: $($record.entry)" }
entries.translation: if (-not $entry) { throw "缺少必需的 SDK 文件：$($record.entry)" }

entries.source: Write-Host "Verified six NVIDIA-signed production DLLs and four licence/notice files in $destinationPath"
entries.translation: Write-Host "已在 $destinationPath 验证六个带有 NVIDIA 签名的生产版 DLL，以及四个许可/声明文件"

entries.source: Write-Host 'Frame generation remains unchanged. See docs/DLSS-FRAME-GENERATION.md to select the correct FG owner.'
entries.translation: Write-Host '帧生成设置保持不变。请参阅 docs/DLSS-FRAME-GENERATION.md 选择正确的帧生成控制方。'

redist.policy: 元数据原样保留；URL、SHA-256、签名指纹、白名单和许可正文不翻译、不重新分发第三方运行库。
